title: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
title_zh: 【输入内容第一行】已是中文（翻译前置工序已翻好），则原样输出该行，不要改写——Manga2Animate：基于脚本与分镜规划的忠实漫画动画智能体框架

paragraphs.en: 总结：研究者提出多智能体框架Manga2Animate，通过动画脚本与分镜规划实现忠于原作的高质量漫画动画生成。 Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/
paragraphs.zh: 总结：研究者提出多智能体框架Manga2Animate，通过动画脚本与分镜规划实现忠于原作的高质量漫画动画生成。 将现有漫画改编为连贯且忠于原作的动画是一项有价值但充满挑战的任务。 现有方法要么主要通过文本访问漫画，从而丢失了其中的人物和艺术风格，要么将漫画页面直接输入视频生成模型，导致模型误读漫画的结构并产生错误的故事情节。 在本文中，我们提出Manga2Animate，一个使生成的每个阶段都立足于源漫画的多智能体框架。 我们将该任务分解为两种中间表示：动画脚本和视觉分镜。 每种表示由一个创建者智能体生成，并由一个配对的审阅者智能体对照源漫画的分格进行审阅。 我们针对每种表示定制了专门的选择机制和双层反馈，在合成最终动画之前逐步优化两者。 大量实验和用户研究表明，与最先进的方法相比，Manga2Animate生成的动画更忠于源漫画，且在镜头之间更加一致。 项目页面：https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/
